info.name: Imara Afya API
info.description: GraphQL API for the Imara Afya health app. Endpoint assumed at {{baseUrl}} (graphql-yoga default). Update `baseUrl` if your server mounts GraphQL elsewhere.

variable.description: The GraphQL endpoint. Change the port/path if needed.
JWT set automatically after a successful Signup.

exec: // save the returned JWT into the collection so the next requests can use it

request.description: Creates an account. Requires agreeToTerms = true, otherwise it fails with TERMS_NOT_ACCEPTED.

graphql.query:
mutation CompleteProfile($input: CompleteProfileInput!) {
  completeProfile(input: $input) {
    id
    firstName
    lastName
    email
    image
    height
    weight
    gender
    religion
    agreedToTerms
  }
}

request.description: Adds profile details after signup. Requires the Bearer token from Signup. gender must be Man or Woman; religion must be Muslim or Christian.

graphql.query:
query Me {
  me {
    id
    firstName
    lastName
    email
    image
    height
    weight
    gender
    religion
    agreedToTerms
  }
}

request.description: Returns the currently authenticated user. Requires the Bearer token.
